name: Burpee
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and clear space behind you.
Squat down, plant your palms flat on the floor, and jump or step both feet back into a high plank.
Briefly steady your shoulders over your wrists with your trunk braced and hips in line.
Jump your feet forward toward your hands, spring straight upward with arms overhead, and land softly into the next repetition.
tips: Brace your core as your feet kick back so your lower back does not sag in the plank.
Land softly with bent knees and step your feet back instead of jumping if needed to keep form crisp.
